description: This Java class defines the Calendar entity within the Fineract project, including properties, constructors, and methods for managing calendar data, recurrence rules, and validation logic.

classes.name: Calendar
classes.description: Entity class representing a calendar with properties, constructors, and methods for managing calendar data, recurrence rules, and validation within the Fineract system.

methods.name: createRepeatingCalendar
methods.description: Static method to create a repeating calendar with specified recurrence parameters.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Static method to instantiate a Calendar object from a JsonCommand input.

methods.name: updateStartDateAndDerivedFeilds
methods.description: Updates the start date and recalculates recurrence rules accordingly.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates calendar properties based on a JsonCommand, with validation and constraints.

methods.name: updateRepeatingCalendar
methods.description: Updates the start date and recurrence of a repeating calendar.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the calendar's title.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the calendar's description.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Returns the calendar's location.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the calendar.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the calendar.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the calendar event.

methods.name: getTypeId
methods.description: Returns the calendar type ID.

methods.name: isRepeating
methods.description: Indicates whether the calendar is set to repeat.

methods.name: getRecurrence
methods.description: Returns the recurrence rule string.

methods.name: getRemindById
methods.description: Returns the reminder type ID.

methods.name: getFirstReminder
methods.description: Returns the first reminder time.

methods.name: getSecondReminder
methods.description: Returns the second reminder time.

methods.name: getMeetingTime
methods.description: Returns the meeting time.

methods.name: getStartDateLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the start date as LocalDate.

methods.name: getEndDateLocalDate
methods.description: Returns the end date as LocalDate.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Returns the set of CalendarHistory objects associated with this calendar.

methods.name: updateStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Updates the start and end dates, and recalculates recurrence.

methods.name: updateCalendarHistory
methods.description: Sets the calendar history records.

methods.name: setRecurrence
methods.description: Sets the recurrence string.
